initial_body:
CLAIM — bit supplier track, OS seed 17.

Base `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`. Exact object: helper 468 in the selected PR589 bit word, after every later literal MOVE/ADD boundary from the original D/A/scatter cut through B/C. PR1256 (`d6d5a994fcdcd8d04ec439ff988daa8f37b17ece`) proves its obstruction at the initial cut, and explicitly leaves later target-read cuts open; PR1128 (`df29b159239b79d7e451d6ddda826a73e0e50a67`) supplies the two-sided footprint contract.

Method: incrementally update all 661 binary input rows and the inverse, exact rational frame spans, helper dirty support, restoration row, and every remaining target dependency. Test any one-common-frame restore-and-isolate block of rank at most 7, with arbitrary scalar mixing/block length and independent dirty auxiliaries; no earlier preparation or new transport. This covers one helper across all later cuts, not another replay of the two old cuts. Seed17 selects helper 468 at index 17 mod 5 among the five initially blocked helpers.

Optimistic screen: ending its residual width at 7 instead of 8 can free a host coordinate; helpers, restoration and source access will be counted for a concrete candidate. Information-access failure rules a cut out even if all added work is free. Expected deliverable: complete exact cut ledger and scoped obstruction or a fully checked narrow candidate, with source pins and negative controls. No new kappa assumed.

Expected finish 2026-10-14 00:13 UTC; final quarter reserved for verification. Claim expires 2026-10-14 01:13 UTC. Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

result.statement: Every original cut excludes a one-common-frame rank-seven isolation block. From cut 177 (B88 MOVE 208:0->152), PR1128's two-sided lemma excludes any permitted reversible linear suffix ending helper 468 below rank eight. The earlier 177 cuts are not existence certificates.
